name: Berwick Boys Foundation Summer Program
description_short: Boys spend the summer on Dyer Island, a 750 acre island off Milbridge, Maine, running their own camp in work crews. They build cabins, run boats, cook and keep the island going, and also sail, swim, fish and take trips; older boys lead the crews.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds. The $100 deposit is non refundable, and nothing is refunded if a boy leaves camp early for any reason.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Boys from age 12, six to eight week season on Dyer Island off the coast of Milbridge; time split between community work crews, personal projects and recreation.

Researched by Claude from this page. Summer 2026 handbook. Boys aged 12 through 21, camp from early July to about mid August. Families are asked to pay $900 per boy or as much as they can afford; fee covers lodging, transport from the West Bridgewater MA headquarters, boat trips, food and laundry. New boys go through an interview, and local boys attend the winter program first.
Researched by Claude from this page. Headquarters at 335 West Street, West Bridgewater, MA 02379.
